entries.title: Genesis 5:1
segments: ¶This is the book of the genealogy of Adam. In the day that God created man, He made him in the likeness of God.

entries.title: Genesis 5:2
segments: He created them male and female, and blessed them and called them Mankind in the day they were created.

entries.title: Genesis 5:3
segments: And Adam lived one hundred and thirty years, and begot [a son] in his own likeness, after his image, and named him Seth.

entries.title: Genesis 5:4
segments: After he begot Seth, the days of Adam were eight hundred years; and he had sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:5
segments: So all the days that Adam lived were nine hundred and thirty years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:6
segments: ¶Seth lived one hundred and five years, and begot Enosh.

entries.title: Genesis 5:7
segments: After he begot Enosh, Seth lived eight hundred and seven years, and had sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:8
segments: So all the days of Seth were nine hundred and twelve years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:9
segments: Enosh lived ninety years, and begot Cainan.

entries.title: Genesis 5:10
segments: After he begot Cainan, Enosh lived eight hundred and fifteen years, and had sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:11
segments: So all the days of Enosh were nine hundred and five years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:12
segments: Cainan lived seventy years, and begot Mahalalel.

entries.title: Genesis 5:13
segments: After he begot Mahalalel, Cainan lived eight hundred and forty years, and had sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:14
segments: So all the days of Cainan were nine hundred and ten years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:15
segments: Mahalalel lived sixty-five years, and begot Jared.

entries.title: Genesis 5:16
segments: After he begot Jared, Mahalalel lived eight hundred and thirty years, and had sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:17
segments: So all the days of Mahalalel were eight hundred and ninety-five years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:18
segments: Jared lived one hundred and sixty-two years, and begot Enoch.

entries.title: Genesis 5:19
segments: After he begot Enoch, Jared lived eight hundred years, and had sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:20
segments: So all the days of Jared were nine hundred and sixty-two years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:21
segments: ¶Enoch lived sixty-five years, and begot Methuselah.

entries.title: Genesis 5:22
segments: After he begot Methuselah, Enoch walked with God three hundred years, and had sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:23
segments: So all the days of Enoch were three hundred and sixty-five years.

entries.title: Genesis 5:24
segments: And Enoch walked with God; and he [was] not, for God took him.

entries.title: Genesis 5:25
segments: ¶Methuselah lived one hundred and eighty-seven years, and begot Lamech.

entries.title: Genesis 5:26
segments: After he begot Lamech, Methuselah lived seven hundred and eighty-two years, and had sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:27
segments: So all the days of Methuselah were nine hundred and sixty-nine years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:28
segments: ¶Lamech lived one hundred and eighty-two years, and had a son.

entries.title: Genesis 5:29
segments: And he called his name Noah, saying, "This [one] will comfort us concerning our work and the toil of our hands, because of the ground which the LORD has cursed."

entries.title: Genesis 5:30
segments: After he begot Noah, Lamech lived five hundred and ninety-five years, and had sons and daughters.

entries.title: Genesis 5:31
segments: So all the days of Lamech were seven hundred and seventy-seven years; and he died.

entries.title: Genesis 5:32
segments: And Noah was five hundred years old, and Noah begot Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
